subTpl.title: Subscription templates
subTpl.subtitle: The config each client app downloads is built from these. Assign one to a host or a user, or set a default per format.
subTpl.order.v2ray_json: Picked in this order: the host's template, then the user's, then the default.
subTpl.order.singbox: Picked in this order: the user's template, then the default.
subTpl.order.clash: Picked in this order: the user's template, then the default.
subTpl.order.subscription_page: The default is shown to everyone who opens their link in a browser.
subTpl.builtinReadOnly: Shipped with Marzallow and read-only. Duplicate it to make your own.
subTpl.fileReadOnly: A file in CUSTOM_TEMPLATES_DIRECTORY, read-only here. Duplicate it to edit it in the dashboard.
subTpl.emptyTitle: Only the built-in {{format}} template so far
subTpl.emptyHelp: Duplicate the built-in template to customise it: routing, DNS, rules.
subTpl.aboutText.v2ray_json: A full Xray client config: its own inbounds, DNS and routing. Every host becomes one complete config in the user's list, and the panel adds that host's outbound to it. Used by v2rayNG, v2rayN, Streisand, Happ and similar apps.
subTpl.aboutText.singbox: The sing-box config: DNS, inbounds and routing. The panel adds every connection as an outbound and fills the selector and urltest groups. Used by sing-box apps (SFA, SFI, Hiddify…).
subTpl.aboutText.clash: The Clash / Clash Meta (mihomo) config. The panel fills the proxies and proxy groups through the conf variable; keep that part. Used by Clash Verge, FlClash, Stash and similar.
subTpl.aboutText.subscription_page: The HTML page people see when they open their subscription link in a browser.
subTpl.variablesHelp: Click to copy. The output must still be valid JSON or YAML.
subTpl.previewHelp.v2ray_json: What this user's V2Ray JSON subscription would be with this template. Hosts with their own template keep it.
subTpl.previewHelp.singbox: What this user's sing-box subscription would be with this template.
subTpl.previewHelp.clash: What this user's Clash subscription would be with this template.
subTpl.previewHelp.subscription_page: The page as this user would see it (scripts don't run in the preview).

access.policyHelp.none: Blocked; only unrestricted users and users on a list can connect anywhere.
